meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: Claude 会通过 Dial 平台拿到一个真实电话号码，替你发短信、打 AI 语音电话，并等待接收别人发来的短信或验证码。它直接运行 dial 命令并告诉你结果。
howto.when: 当你提到电话、短信、验证码等关键词，或要求给某人发短信、打电话时触发；在本会话首次运行 dial 命令前也会先加载。

say.text: 用 dial 给 +14155550123 发条短信，说明天见面改到三点
用 dial 给 +14155550123 打个电话，告诉对方订单已发货
say.note: 由 AI 语音代理拨打并说明

say.text: 帮我等一条验证码短信，收到后把内容告诉我
say.note: 等待并解析收到的短信

howto.what_en: Claude can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and wait for incoming texts and verification codes through the Dial platform using a real phone number. It runs dial commands for you and reports back.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention phones, texts, SMS, OTP or verification codes, ask to text or call someone, or before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.text: Use dial to text +14155550123 that we moved to 3pm
Call +14155550123 with dial and say the order shipped
Wait for a verification code and tell me what it says
say_en.note: Waits for and parses the inbound SMS
